fusions.name: Split Tine
fusions.desc: Hurls a tine of antler at an enemy for 4 piercing damage. It then splits to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Prong Pair
fusions.desc: Looses 2 prongs of horn at once, spread wide, each dealing 9 piercing damage and stunning its target for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scattered Herd
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies within 5 tiles for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 10% faster while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Branch Strike
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a second tine leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
